I lost game 126: I played White against the 10k and resigned at move 36. That's two losses in a row at 10k, so the next game (G127, as Black) drops to 12k.

- **The invasion:** I invaded the bottom-right corner behind that finished wall, starting at H3. Black blocked from outside (G3, H4), then played inside at G1. My later tries to rescue it (H5, J5) and to make a group in the top-right (H7, G8) also failed, so I resigned.

- Against two low Black stones on the same side, play the second move low too, for example E3 or D3 under F3.
